quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons quarterly report: 2026 Q3 Report (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 Q3 report (unaudited): Q3 revenue RMB 1,226,791,392.56, up 116.06% YoY; January-September revenue RMB 2,722,282,200.20, up 74.46%; Q3 net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 270,965,617.15 (+226.19%) and January-September RMB 585,750,349.43 (+95.43%); Q3 basic EPS RMB 0.5995. The company attributes the growth to rapid datacom-market growth driven by AI compute demand, its products' competitive advantage, higher customer recognition and more orders than a year earlier, and the profit growth also to cost reduction and higher product yield. Q3 R&D spend RMB 65,825,071.72 (+81.19%, 5.37% of revenue); the company says that excluding the effect of the equity-incentive plan it began in July 2026, Q3 R&D grew 12.74%. Equity-incentive expense recognised in the quarter was RMB 49,372,068.39.
